name: How much does it cost to remodel a bathroom in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remodel a bathroom in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom remodeling costs in Orange County can vary significantly based on size, material choices, and the extent of the renovation. A basic refresh might start around $10,000 to $15,000, while a mid-range remodel often falls between $20,000 and $40,000. High-end, custom remodels with premium materials and complex designs can exceed $50,000. These are general estimates, and we provide a detailed, itemized quote after a consultation to match your specific project and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom remodel costs in Orange County range from $10,000 for basic updates to over $50,000 for high-end renovations, varying by size and materials.
